sub_dimensions.name: Formatting & Scanability

scoring_criteria.0: Single block of text or inconsistent formatting
scoring_criteria.5: Basic formatting present but lacks emphasis or clarity
scoring_criteria.10: Capitalized headers, line breaks, and concise bullet structure

sop_checklist: Each point starts with a capitalized feature header
Bullets use short sentences or phrases, not paragraphs
edge_cases: If bullets are too lengthy or read like paragraphs, score ≤5
Score 0 if fewer than 3 bullet points

sub_dimensions.name: Value Prop Clarity

scoring_criteria.0: Only technical features, no benefit or value explained
scoring_criteria.5: Some benefits mentioned but not consistent
scoring_criteria.10: Each bullet connects a feature with a clear customer benefit

edge_cases: If bullet includes fluff without substance, cap at 6
If features are repeated across bullets, score ≤5

formatting_and_scanability: - Begin each bullet with a capitalized header followed by a colon
- Use 5 bullet points minimum to cover varied benefits
- Avoid long paragraphs or combining multiple features in one bullet
value_prop_clarity: - Add customer-centric benefits after technical features (e.g., 'so you can...')
- Highlight unique selling points clearly and avoid repetition
- Naturally include relevant keywords customers search for
